svg.title: Confirmed 3-wire RJ45 to DB9 wiring for PAX L920-BE
svg.desc: Only 3 wires needed: RJ45 pins 5, 6, 7 to DB9 pins 1, 3, 4. Confirmed working with GHL UOB integration.
svg.text: Confirmed working — only 3 wires needed (T568B standard)
Clip facing away, left to right

g.text: FTDI chipsets do not work with this setup
Must use Prolific PL2303 / PL2303GT — confirmed by testing
